title: Mold Remediation: One Open Job per Location and the Claim File Mold Sublimit
content:
No other Mold Remediation job of the same customer for the same address and growth location may be open when a new job is booked. A job is open in every status except closed and cancelled.

The policy's mold sublimit on a claim file is one limit for the whole loss: insurance proceeds posted to all mold jobs linked to the same claim file together may never exceed the claim file's mold sublimit, and when the claim file's mold sublimit is 0.00 no insurance proceeds are posted to a mold job at all. Charges above what the sublimit covers stay owed by the customer on the job.

## Booking a new job

- **Evidence**: the company's own job records, read before the job is booked: the customer, the loss address, the growth location and the status of every existing mold job. A customer's statement does not replace the records.
- **Same object**: an existing job matters only when all three of customer, address and growth location match the job being booked.
- **Open statuses**: scheduled, authorized, remediating, awaiting clearance, cleared and invoiced. Closed and cancelled jobs are not open.

| Existing job, same customer, address and growth location (hypothetical) | New job may be booked |
|---|---|
| Status invoiced | No |
| Status closed | Yes |
| Status cancelled | Yes |

## The mold sublimit across jobs

The sublimit is measured across the claim file as the sum of insurance proceeds posted to every mold job linked to that file.

Hypothetical: a claim file carries a mold sublimit of 7000.00, and 5200.00 has already been posted to one of its mold jobs. All mold jobs of that file can together receive at most 1800.00 more; any charges on them above what the sublimit covers stay owed by the customer. With a sublimit of 0.00, no insurance proceeds are posted to any mold job of the file.
